issues.where: Crop 1, right edge of the flower disk at about 3 o’clock
issues.what: The rows of disk florets stop around an angular notch filled by a flat orange patch; it looks as if the ray-petal bases cut through the disk surface.
issues.fix: Seat the ray florets behind the disk rim and carry irregular disk florets and small occlusion shadows across the join.

issues.where: Crops 1 and 2, exposed ray petals on the left of the bud; also visible in set-C-05.png, crop 2
issues.what: The bright petals have similarly spaced, high-contrast lengthwise grooves that run almost to their tips and make the surfaces look like molded ribbons.
issues.fix: Soften and break up the grooves, vary their spacing and strength from petal to petal, and keep the thin backlit edges translucent.

issues.where: Upper-left sky and field around the low sun
issues.what: Long radial spokes fan out across the dark cloud and continue below the horizon with little change in structure, making the flare look laid over the scene.
issues.fix: Shorten and soften the optical starburst, and let any atmospheric shafts vary with cloud occlusion and haze depth.

issues.where: Crops 8 and 9, right midground rows and dark skyline behind them; also visible in set-C-03.png
issues.what: Several straight stalks and dark-centered orange rings look nearly interchangeable, then the field ends at a single nearly solid dark band. The depth reads as stacked layers rather than a field receding into the distance.
issues.fix: Vary head angle, stalk lean and spacing, and stagger the distant silhouettes with gradual atmospheric contrast falloff while preserving defocus.
